body: ## Pull request overview Automatically enables embedded sub-windows (single-window mode) on Windows in specific virtualized GPU scenarios to mitigate OpenGL multi-window flicker, and suppresses background erasing to reduce resize/show flashes. **Changes:** - Add a `DisplayServer` base flag + getter to indicate when embedding subwindows is recommended. - Detect (intended) Hyper-V/virtualized environments on Windows and set the recommendation flag when running OpenGL without a Vulkan context. - Auto-enable embedding subwindows at startup when the recommendation flag is set; suppress default `WM_ERASEBKGND` handling to reduce flicker. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | servers/display/display_server.h | Adds a base-class recommendation flag and a public accessor. | | platform/windows/display_server_windows.cpp | Implements Windows-side detection and sets the recommendation; changes `WM_ERASEBKGND` handling. | | main/main.cpp | Enables embedding subwindows when the display server recommends it. | --- 💡 Add Copilot custom instructions for smarter, more guided reviews.
